Collection of vector simplification algorithms.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Simplify, OmsLineSmootherMcMaster, OmsLineSmootherJaitools<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.VectorSimplifier`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inVector` | vector file |  |  | The vector to be simplified. |
| `pType` | String |  | `TopologyPreservingSimplifier` | The simplification method. Allowed values: `TopologyPreservingSimplifier`, `Douglas Peucker`, `Reduce coordinate precision`. |
| `pTolerance` | double |  | `0.2` | The distance tolerance for the simplification. |
| `pScale` | Double |  | `1000.0` | The amount by which to multiply a coordinate after subtracting the offset, to obtain a precise coordinate |
